name: Abraham
overview: The Scriptures introduce Abraham, originally called Abram, as the son of Terah who married Sarai and left Ur of the Chaldees with his family to journey toward the land of Canaan. God called Abram to leave his country and promised to make him a great nation, blessing him and making his name great so that he would be a blessing to others. This divine call marks the beginning of God's covenant relationship with Abraham, setting the foundation for the unfolding plan of redemption.
